Elite Amazon Bows, Spears and Javelins
(Normal Amazon Bows, Spears and Javelins | Exceptional Amazon Bows, Spears and Javelins)

Amazon Weapons can only be equipped by Amazons.

Amazon Bows can have +1, +2 or +3 to Bow and Crossbow Skills. Spears and Javelins can have +1, +2, or +3 to Javelin and Spear Skills.

Auto Mods
Amazon auto modifiers show up on all Amazon Bows, Amazon Javelins, and Amazon Spears, whether they are of low quality (Cracked, Crude, Damaged, Low Quality), normal quality, Superior, magic, or rare. One affix from a given group is chosen, based on the level of the item and the levels of the auto mods available. Auto mods with higher (affix) frequency are more likely to spawn. [Learn more]
